mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rpt_stat_daily (tunnel_id, stat_date, warn_total, warn_red, warn_confirmed, warn_closed, dispose_total, dispose_closed, patrol_total, patrol_done, hazard_new, hazard_closed, sample_count, sample_expect, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tunnelId}, #{statDate}, #{warnTotal}, #{warnRed}, #{warnConfirmed}, #{warnClosed}, #{disposeTotal}, #{disposeClosed}, #{patrolTotal}, #{patrolDone}, #{hazardNew}, #{hazardClosed}, #{sampleCount}, #{sampleExpect}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE warn_total = VALUES(warn_total), warn_red = VALUES(warn_red), warn_confirmed = VALUES(warn_confirmed), warn_closed = VALUES(warn_closed), dispose_total = VALUES(dispose_total), dispose_closed = VALUES(dispose_closed), patrol_total = VALUES(patrol_total), patrol_done = VALUES(patrol_done), hazard_new = VALUES(hazard_new), hazard_closed = VALUES(hazard_closed), sample_count = VALUES(sample_count), sample_expect = VALUES(sample_expect), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT stat_date FROM rpt_stat_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT tunnel_id AS tunnelId, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(warn_level = 4) AS red, SUM(warn_status >= 2 AND warn_status != 6) AS confirmed, SUM(warn_status = 5) AS closed FROM warn_event WHERE create_time >= #{from} AND create_time < #{to} GROUP BY tunnel_id

SELECT e.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(t.status = 3) AS closed FROM warn_dispose_task t JOIN warn_event e ON e.id = t.event_id WHERE t.create_time >= #{from} AND t.create_time < #{to} AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.tunnel_id
SELECT tunnel_id AS tunnelId, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(status = 3) AS done FROM patrol_task WHERE plan_time >= #{from} AND plan_time < #{to} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY tunnel_id

SELECT tunnel_id AS tunnelId, SUM(discover_time >= #{from} AND discover_time < #{to}) AS newCnt, SUM(close_time >= #{from} AND close_time < #{to}) AS closed FROM patrol_hazard WHERE ((discover_time >= #{from} AND discover_time < #{to}) OR (close_time >= #{from} AND close_time < #{to})) AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY tunnel_id
SELECT point_id AS pointId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM data_sample WHERE ts >= #{from} AND ts < #{to} GROUP BY point_id
SELECT id AS pointId, tunnel_id AS tunnelId, collect_freq_sec AS freq FROM mon_point WHERE enabled = 1 AND collect_enabled = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
